원문 PASSAGE
1Emma was a talented vocalist but struggled to gain recognition. 2Lisa, who went to the same high school with her, had quickly become famous with powerful performances. 3Emma felt jealous watching Lisa's success. 4One day, Emma decided to enter a major vocal competition in the capital city. 5She spent months preparing her masterpiece of a performance, hoping this would finally be her opportunity to shine. 6When the competition day arrived, Emma felt nervous. 7Walking into the concert hall, Emma saw a large audience cheering for Lisa. 8She couldn't help but compare herself to Lisa. 9On her turn, Emma performed with all her heart, pouring her months of preparation into every note. 10The judges then evaluated each vocalist's performance carefully. 11Finally, the results were announced. 12To her surprise, Emma got first place, not Lisa. 13Moments later, Lisa came over to congratulate Emma with a warm smile. 14She said, "Your hard work and dedication really paid off. I'm so happy for you." 15She didn't seem bothered by the results. 16"I'm proud that your singing brings joy to people," said Lisa. 17Emma felt grateful for Lisa's kindness. 18Lisa added, "I've always been moved by your effort and have been supporting you all along." 19These words made Emma feel embarrassed at her jealousy. 20At the same time, she got inspired to find a better path forward. 21They hugged warmly, their bond strengthened. 22From that day on, they supported each other and even sang on the same stage together. 23Emma became more confident and, finally, got a chance to have her solo concert.
전체 해석
1Emma는 재능 있는 성악가였지만 인정을 받으려고 애를 먹었다. 2그녀와 같은 고등학교에 다닌 Lisa는 강렬한 공연으로 빠르게 유명해졌다. 3Emma는 Lisa의 성공을 지켜보며 질투를 느꼈다. 4어느 날, Emma는 수도에서 열리는 큰 성악 대회에 참가하기로 결심했다. 5그녀는 이것이 마침내 빛날 자신의 기회가 되기를 바라며 몇 달 동안 자신의 걸작 같은 공연을 준비했다. 6대회 날이 오자, Emma는 긴장했다. 7콘서트홀로 걸어 들어가며, Emma는 많은 청중이 Lisa를 응원하는 것을 보았다. 8그녀는 자신을 Lisa와 비교하지 않을 수 없었다. 9자기 차례에, Emma는 온 마음을 다해 공연했고, 자신의 몇 달간의 준비를 음 하나하나에 쏟아부었다. 10그런 다음 심사위원들은 각 성악가의 공연을 신중하게 평가했다. 11마침내, 결과가 발표되었다. 12놀랍게도, Lisa가 아니라 Emma가 1등을 차지했다. 13잠시 후, Lisa가 따뜻한 미소를 지으며 Emma를 축하하러 다가왔다. 14그녀는 말했다. "너의 노력과 헌신이 정말 결실을 맺었어. 정말 기뻐." 15그녀는 결과에 개의치 않는 듯 보였다. 16"네 노래가 사람들에게 기쁨을 준다는 게 자랑스러워"라고 Lisa가 말했다. 17Emma는 Lisa의 친절에 고마움을 느꼈다. 18Lisa가 덧붙였다. "난 늘 네 노력에 감동했고, 줄곧 너를 응원해 왔어." 19이 말은 Emma가 자신의 질투를 부끄러워하게 만들었다. 20동시에, 그녀는 더 나은 길을 찾도록 영감을 받았다. 21그들은 따뜻하게 포옹했고, 그들의 유대는 더 단단해졌다. 22그날 이후로, 그들은 서로를 응원했고 심지어 같은 무대에서 함께 노래했다. 23Emma는 더 자신감을 갖게 되었고, 마침내 자신의 단독 콘서트를 열 기회를 얻었다.

영영풀이
1.talented: having a natural ability to do something well
2.jealous: feeling unhappy because someone has something you want
3.competition: an event where people compete to win a prize
4.evaluate: to judge the value or quality of something carefully
5.congratulate: to tell someone you are happy about their success

한글 해석 연습

1.
Emma was a talented vocalist but struggled to gain recognition.
2.
Lisa, who went to the same high school with her, had quickly become famous with powerful performances.
3.
Emma felt jealous watching Lisa's success.
4.
One day, Emma decided to enter a major vocal competition in the capital city.
5.
She spent months preparing her masterpiece of a performance, hoping this would finally be her opportunity to shine.
6.
When the competition day arrived, Emma felt nervous.
7.
Walking into the concert hall, Emma saw a large audience cheering for Lisa.
8.
She couldn't help but compare herself to Lisa.
9.
On her turn, Emma performed with all her heart, pouring her months of preparation into every note.
10.
The judges then evaluated each vocalist's performance carefully.
11.
Finally, the results were announced.
12.
To her surprise, Emma got first place, not Lisa.
13.
Moments later, Lisa came over to congratulate Emma with a warm smile.
14.
She said, "Your hard work and dedication really paid off. I'm so happy for you."
15.
She didn't seem bothered by the results.
16.
"I'm proud that your singing brings joy to people," said Lisa.
17.
Emma felt grateful for Lisa's kindness.
18.
Lisa added, "I've always been moved by your effort and have been supporting you all along."
19.
These words made Emma feel embarrassed at her jealousy.
20.
At the same time, she got inspired to find a better path forward.
21.
They hugged warmly, their bond strengthened.
22.
From that day on, they supported each other and even sang on the same stage together.
23.
Emma became more confident and, finally, got a chance to have her solo concert.
